grh_ecdbf616a4cc9e1b1147.title: John Hansen, Hermit
paragraphs: Television producer Chandler discovers recluse John Hansen living quietly in a city park and sees him as perfect material for a human-interest program. John reluctantly agrees to appear only because the publicity and prizes might help a young boy he has befriended. The broadcast turns Hansen into a curiosity and surrounds him with unwanted possessions, attention and strangers, destroying the solitude that gave his life meaning. When he retreats to the park, the boy condemns Chandler for exploiting a man who asked for nothing except to be left alone.
